description_en: Adds an ECS resource or service to a resource group
description_zh: 调用JoinResourceGroup将一个ECS资源或者服务加入一个资源组
kebab_example: aliyun ecs join-resource-group --resource-type securitygroup --resource-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: JoinResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The type of the ECS resource. Valid values:

instance: instance.
disk: block storage.
snapshot: snapshot.
image: image.
securitygroup: security group.
ddh: dedicated host.
ddhcluster: dedicated host cluster.
eni: network interface controller (NIC).
keypair: key pair.
launchtemplate: launch template.
command: Cloud Assistant command.
activation: Cloud Assistant managed instance activation code.
managedinstance: Cloud Assistant managed instance.

The preceding parameter values are case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
ECS资源的类型。取值范围：

instance：实例。
disk：块存储。
snapshot：快照。
image：镜像。
securitygroup：安全组。
ddh：专有宿主机。
ddhcluster：专有宿主机集群。
eni：弹性网卡。
keypair：密钥对。
launchtemplate：启动模板。
command：云助手命令。
activation：云助手托管实例激活码。
managedinstance：云助手托管实例。

以上参数取值均大小写敏感
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. For example, when ResourceType is set to instance, ResourceId is the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型的ID标识符。例如，当ResourceType=instance时，则ResourceId可以理解为InstanceId。
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
